notes.title: The Slot-Crafting💡🧁
notes.content:
Greetings, Star Seekers!🌟

After our initial playtests, one feature clearly stood out as needing the most improvement: the [b]crafting system[/b]. While combining multiple materials to create wild and unique items was fun, the process itself required too many steps, and the interface wasn't as intuitive as we wanted.

Let’s break it down.

[h3]Slow Start[/h3]
In the earlier versions of the system (we had a few iterations...), crafting a new item required the player to:
1. Find the correct [b]crafting station[/b] on the level.
2. Place it in the Briefbase. 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44877550/b2672c73c713a6dd38ea396d7b74acb73b23d2a9.gif[/img]
3. Gather the necessary resources.
4. Access the crafting station physically or through a large crafter selection screen.
5. Select a [b]recipe [/b] or set up a new composition of materials. 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44877550/bd32b59e5f3c3dd90405a184c05139287e944870.gif[/img]
6. Click OK once you’ve created something with a specific composition for the first time.
[b]Too long! [/b]

[h3]Let's speed things up![/h3]
The new version, internally called "Item Creation v4," simplifies the process significantly:
1. Find* an appropriate crafting [b]base item[/b]—like a cupcake with slots. 
2. Gather resources.
3. [b]Drag [/b]the resource onto the base. 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44877550/0a10e3fadf82a7d07df7b7fd37d712b5a79f82cb.gif[/img]

[b]It’s that simple! [/b]

Our setting allows players to mix any kind of ingredients, so if you want to combine cotton candy with rusty nails, go ahead—just maybe don’t eat it yourself! 🧁📌🔨

*NOTE:
The current version of the game [b]does not[/b] have the option to [b]create base items[/b] on your own. This will be included in future updates. For the time being, we scattered plenty of them across the Sanctuary for you to try out the system itself. 

[h3]Quality-of-life improvements[/h3]
The key is [b]convenience[/b]. The easier the system is to use, the more likely it will be used often. That’s why we’ve added two alternative ways to make the process even smoother:

I. [b]Interactive Details Panel[/b]
You can now select a slot-filler directly from the details panel of any base item.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44877550/137669b77193101b734110337e3d8da9abfc4a15.gif[/img]

II. [b]Precise Crafting[/b]
If you love experimenting or testing combinations before hitting the craft button, simply right-click on a base item to bring up a dedicated crafting window with a "[b]Randomize[/b]" option for extra fun.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44877550/1c0c66dae0a7bec1f9c984e6e360d012edd3e5d0.gif[/img]

[h3]Clearing Slots[/h3]
Lastly, if you’re unhappy with your creation or need those materials elsewhere, you can always [b]Clear Slots[/b] without any cost. We want to encourage experimentation, so there’s no penalty for trying out new combinations. :)

[h3]Visual changes[/h3]
To get even more satisfaction from mixing various ingredients, we are also focusing on alternating the visual representation of the base items. We have a prototype that works on changing colors, but it doesn't seem to cut it. If we are making a Cotton Candy Jacket, we want to see a character covered in cotton candy!!! 

[h3]What do you think?[/h3]
We’d love to hear your thoughts on this new crafting system! What wild combinations are you excited to try? Let us know in the comments, and share your favorite creations with the community. Your feedback helps shape the future of To the Star, so don’t hesitate to tell us what you’d like to see next!

P.S.
Kudos to Damien Monnier from Exit Plan Games, who co-designed this mechanic!

notes.title: 🌱 Gardening #101: How to Get Rid of the Pests 🌱
notes.content:
Slugs got you down in Across the Wonderlands? Fear not, Star Seekers! Here’s your quick guide to handling those slimy pests:

[h3]1. Shrink Them[/h3]
One of the best ways to deal with slugs is by shrinking them. Throw a dish packed with [b]Electricity [/b](supplied by Cotton Candy) at them! That’s why you’ll notice so many Rabid Candies running around the Sanctuary. ;) 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44877550/14ed88d1ed7d3a8435b9caae59e28be27483bb39.gif[/img]

[h3]2. Blow Them Up[/h3]
Place a [b]Popping Poppy[/b] near a slug and watch it explode! But be careful—the blast can hit you, too. If you throw a Waterberry at the Poppy before it detonates, the explosion will be even more powerful!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44877550/e9efea2219c9f3f1a996670c4a0288cb50d5cef3.gif[/img]

[h3]3. Let Them Float[/h3]
Got flash-banged by a big slug’s detachable tentacle? No worries! Stun them back by shooting [b]Colorful Sprinkles[/b] at them. You can collect these from Flying Fish. Either… you know… ahem harvest the fish quickly, or feed them Slug Meat and wait until they poop it out. ;) 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44877550/bd4d26825095961a0833782183e1210f18501406.gif[/img]

[h3]4. Make Them Fall[/h3]
If you’ve built the [b]Puff Propeller,[/b] use it to send smaller slugs flying into the air and watch them bounce joyfully. Then, recall your Briefcase while they’re high up. It’s not the most humane method, but it’s highly effective! 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44877550/80f9da1619080ae6f3ee64b1c0817b8c7dbb88b8.gif[/img]

[h3]5. Distract with a Rabid Candy[/h3]
Slugs don’t like those pink Rabid Candies. Just place one nearby to distract them. You can even throw a Popping Poppy with glue onto a Rabid Candy near a slug for a makeshift [b]kamikaze attack[/b]!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44877550/1cea502b8f33c27120b3a50ec53a5b51de2fc5bd.gif[/img]

[h3]6. Take Down Their Armor[/h3]
Mix up some ingredients that reduce a target’s armor and throw it at the slug. Then bash away while they’re weakened. #TheBoringMethod
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44877550/37bc8cfd4634c6f61b39f085112fcd4d50c8d5b3.gif[/img]

[h3]7. Suck Them Into the Vortex[/h3]
Got a [b]Briefcase Vortex[/b]? Use it to suck in the slugs, but beware—they’ll still be alive, roaming inside your Briefbase, so stay alert! It only works on small and tiny slugs, though.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44877550/fb86c1d49de440bb953beb3f94b04f472b89de9a.gif[/img]

P.S.
[b]Fire makes slugs grow[/b]—great for harvesting their shell fragments (very sharp)! Combine the Burning status with a [b]Surprise [/b]emotion to make a bigger slug spawn loot without needing to fight!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44877550/8f7af3c973e61edb045fef29135a7622faf47baa.gif[/img]

notes.title: Appetizer Demo in the Steam Next Fest 🌠💻
notes.content:
Hello, Star Seekers!

We’re thrilled to announce that Across the Wonderlands will be part of the Steam Next Fest with a special Appetizer Demo! After our initial round of closed community playtests earlier this year, we’ve taken your valuable feedback to heart and made some exciting updates to the game. 

🔧Here are the most significant changes we’ve made since the playtests:
[list]
[*] You can now [b]eat every material[/b] and ingredient you find and throw/shoot any equipped item!
[*] You can [b]smash every deposit[/b] on the level for materials!
[*] Redesigned [b]crafting system [/b]for a smoother, more intuitive experience while keeping it open and elaborate.
[*] Integrated progression system with gathering and building mechanics, resulting in the birth of [b]Skillbuildings[/b].
[*] Added the first [b]Briefcase abilities[/b], including the Puff Propeller (try to throw it under a small slug) and Briefcase Vortex (try to throw it at a small slug!).
[*] Introduced [b]creature nurturing[/b] and plant growing features to expand your gameplay options.
[*] Improved level design for a more immersive and challenging experience.
[*] Made key combat and balancing improvements to refine the action.
[*] Completely reworked the [b]tutorial flow[/b] to match these new changes.
[*] [b]Save system [/b]support was added to increase flexibility in play sessions.
[*] Enhanced build stability to ensure a smoother gameplay experience.
[/list]
With these updates, we feel confident and ready for the [b]next round of feedback[/b]. That’s why we’re excited to participate in the [b]Steam Next Fest[/b]! Your insights will help us take the game to the next level.

🎮 Jump into the [b]Appetizer Demo[/b] during Steam Next Fest, and do not forget to leave a review! 🌟
